turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
First, watch me do one.
The word is "apple". It starts with the sound "a". That is a vowel sound. So: She eats an apple.
Rule: say an before a vowel sound, and a before other sounds.
Right: He has a hat. Wrong: He has an hat.

Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
